title: The 1948 quartet and spot jobs around the area
summary: Asked about 1948, Williams says he played spots in Lafitte, Shell Beach and other towns, plus New Year's jobs at Burgundy.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: It was in January and he was in England. But anyway, it says here, he joined drummer Adley Williams to form a quartet in 1948. Where did you all play?

Right here in 1948 I was here playing spots. You know? I was in spots. I was from here to Lafitte, all in Lafitte I had. And then down here's hometown all around Englandstown, Delicole Island, Shell Beach, Wild Kloster, Englandstown, and Parlin' Hash.
What about Polga and Burgundy? You used to play there didn't you?
When was that? That was about 59 or something.
Oh yeah, that's, well I played some jobs out there. Yeah, I played out there New Year's, New Year's Eve night.
New Year's Eve night. But they had a down at Burgundy and Maroney at the gym. Who was sponsored, sponsored was the concert of the Filipinos.
